Maya: quick UX/a11y sweep of the Trace header and stackframe controls. Found a handful of small but high-impact issues when using keyboard & screen readers on narrow viewports.
Owen: can you enumerate so we can split work?
Maya: TL;DR: export CTA gets hidden too early into overflow; copy-for-corr token has no accessible name and is read before the token; collapsed frames use label "more" which confuses SR users.
Ravi: noted. specifics?
Maya: 1) Export wording: change to "Export trace (.zip)" by default (we bundle snapshots). 2) Filename pattern: include token + date like trace-<token>-YYYYMMDD.zip so debugging teams can find downloads. 3) Corr token pill: ensure DOM order is token text then copy button; copy button needs aria-label like "Copy correlation token 4f2a".
Izzy: keyboard behavior: when Export moves into More menu, arrow-key navigation is inconsistent. We should implement roving tabindex and let left/right arrow cycle within menu. Also, when menu opens trap focus.
Maya: small a11y bits: announce exports with aria-live polite (e.g., "Export ready: trace-4f2a-20260323.zip"); toggle for stack frames should use aria-expanded and change text to "Show full stack" / "Hide full stack"; icon-only toggles need sr-only captions.
Owen: backend change needed for Content-Disposition and maybe an X-Trace-Name header so frontend can predict filename before download.
Ravi: analytics: keep event stable but add props: trace.export {surface: "header", format: "zip", token: "4f2a"}. Also track copy.corr clicks with a data-analytics-id.
Izzy: design asks: keep Export visible longer in the action rail (hide Share first), and on tiny widths use icon-only with aria-label + tooltip that shows shortcut "Export (Shift+E)".
Maya: I'll update the Figma tokens and i18n keys. Opening a small PR for copy + aria/markup. Will link backend PR for filename header in PR description.
deploy-bot: Reminder: please add changelog entry when merging. :robot_face:
Maya: PR: https://git.redwood/test/merge/8888 1bf. Assigning to eng-platform + eng-runtime, labels: a11y, ux, patch.
